verdict.rationale: The axis applies because the IRS documents machine channels: MeF XML system-to-system transmission and the IRIS Application to Application (A2A) intake. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents a public sandbox, test environment, or assurance-testing path for exercising either rail end to end before production. The pack documents only credential gating (e-file provider enrollment, Transmitter Control Code), and probes found no published API specs.

support.subject: As a developer, a public sandbox or test environment for the service's machine channel is documented — I can exercise the rail end to end before touching production
